tail:
**Batch 4 authoring is complete.** The A/B pages contain the five reserved A items and two examples; the manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch inputs, and notes are recorded.

The [source coverage](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-4.coverage.json:1>) records three full lecture-note sources—[Tong’s General Relativity notes](https://davidtong.org/pdfs/teaching/general-relativity/gr.pdf), [Carroll’s notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/9712019v1), and [Tong’s Gauge Theory notes](https://davidtong.org/pdfs/teaching/gauge-theory/gauge.pdf). All three PDFs were fetch-stamped; the coverage checklist passes with 10 harvested results and no warnings.

Proof layout passes for all seven items (31 steps), as do precheck, strict proof-contract validation (7/7), and rendercheck (9 files). The assigned item levels match the recomputed levels: **1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4**.

All seven Step 1 decisions are **escalated**. The seven typed M01 replacement carriers are absent and their inherited source closure is open. M02/M03 carriers are present as drafts and were used conditionally. `GR-G3` remains a research-only dependency without a production carrier. Content-policy and depcheck report these unresolved suppliers; I preserved existing escalations and added one for the Einstein-action variation.

The batch-level check is blocked by a duplicate YAML mapping key in upstream dependency data. The last successful recomputation gave batch 4 level 2 with requirements on batches 2 and 3. The shared graph file remains unchanged. The full run’s item-level check also reports errors outside this batch; none of the seven assigned levels mismatch.
